measurement_note: Size S is the target n, with m = 3 so the available primes are 2, 3, and 5 at every tier. Targets 16, 32, and 64 span 4x and require increasing numbers of repeated selections. The one-dimensional minimum-count DP visits each sum-prime pair once; a correct count-by-sum table that retains every possible number of selected terms performs an additional factor of n work and must fail only scaling.
